OV-001 rules that ITEM counts do not change for the Wide variant, but sprinkler spacing is AREA-driven and FP-1 is a separate shop drawing, not A555 — OV-001 does not cover it. FP-1 SCHEDULES TWO GUESTROOM-PLAUSIBLE HEAD TYPES AND FLOOR 1 IS MOSTLY THE OTHER ONE — CORRECTED FROM THE DRAFT, which cited only one row: row ◉ = 62 first floor / 437 all floors, VK430 7/16 FR 155 C PD, K=4.3, 1/2" thread, ON DROP; row ⊗ = 73 first floor / 101 all floors, VK462 1/2 QR 155 B CC, K=5.6, ON DROP; plus row O = 7/7 VK468 and row ◄ = 2/2 VK305 on sprig. ALL OTHER HEADS TO BE SEMI-RECESSED' and a guest room is not a public area, while packages/fire-appliance.md reads FP-1's 'PD' suffix as concealed pendent. Do not put a temperature rating on any purchase document off this row: FP-1 has no temperature column, the '155' sits inside the model string and the 'C' is undecoded. lines.label: Addressable photoelectric smoke detector on a LOW-FREQUENCY sounder base — Silent Knight SKPHOTOW head in a System Sensor B200S-LF-WH 520 Hz sounder base, ceiling mounted. This base is the audible appliance for a sleeping room; a corridor horn does not satisfy it
lines.where: Room ceiling near the entry / sleeping boundary — A555 view 06 (entry door / mirror wall) draws the SD symbol; not in the bath
lines.instanceNote: DOWNGRADED FROM THE DRAFT'S HIGH — THE COUNT IS DERIVED, NOT READ, FOR THIS ROOM TYPE. The arithmetic is sound: FA-1 schedules 121 x SKPHOTOW + 121 x B200S-LF-WH, which reconciles exactly to 115 keys + the 6 second detectors in the 6 one-bedroom units, and A100's matrix puts no one-bedroom on floor 1 — so 1 per key on this floor is well argued. But packages/fire-appliance.md rates the row covering QQ Wide Connecting at MEDIUM and states in terms that it was NOT read off FA-2/FA-3 for these types; the 303/305/307/311 and 304/306/308 verifications are OTHER room types. Well-argued arithmetic is MEDIUM, not HIGH — the same extraction gap flagged loudly for sprinklers on this exact room. THE LOW-FREQUENCY SOUNDER BASE IS THE AUDIBLE APPLIANCE FOR THIS SLEEPING ROOM — a corridor horn does not satisfy it. FA-1's audibility chart: sleeping rooms ambient 35 dBA, design 75 dBA, low frequency, visual required. (Note E500 FA note 17's 15-dBA-over-ambient criterion would give only 50 dBA; the submittal is more onerous and governs — test to 75.) Each detector carries TWO addresses on FA-2/FA-3, an SLC address and a NAC/power-supply circuit — get both read back at the panel. E500 FA note 10 requires emergency-system junction boxes and cover plates to be PAINTED RED; any exposed FA plate in this finished room is red or it is a punch item. SETTLES IT: read the FA-2 first-floor region for 101 — the same document-reading task that closes the sprinkler row.
lines.src: FA-1 schedule row (S)SB — 121 SKPHOTOW + 121 B200S-LF-WH; FA-1 scope of work and audibility chart; FA-2/FA-3 verified on 303/305/307/311 and 304/306/308 (other room types); E501-E504 + E400; A555 view 06 (SD symbol, keynote 16); E500 FA notes 10 and 17; packages/fire-appliance.md §2.4
lines.verifyAtPunch: With the FA vendor: alarm the head and confirm the 520 Hz sounder base sounds IN this room and meters at least 75 dBA at the pillow, and that the FACP annunciates room 101; read back both addresses; confirm any exposed FA plate is painted RED.

lines.label: Fire horn (standard rooms) / horn-strobe (communication-features rooms) — record PRESENT or ABSENT
lines.where: Room ceiling or wall beside the smoke detector — A555 view 06 draws SD and H symbols together and carries keynote 16
lines.instanceNote: DB GAP AND A LIVE DOCUMENT CONFLICT — the DB has no row, and its smoke-detector note has already adopted one side ('NO horn/strobe in a standard key'). QUANTITY MAY BE 1 OR ZERO. FOR (architectural permit set): A555 draws an (H) symbol beside the SD on view 06 and places keynote 16, verbatim 'FIRE HORN IN STANDARD ROOMS / FIRE HORN/STROBE IN COMMUNICATION FEATURES ROOMS'; keynote 16 is also in A555's placed list for views 04/04.1; the A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND carries 'ALARM HORN AND STROBE (H)'; E101's legend mounts combination horn/strobes at 6'-8" AFF; E501-E504 print 'per guestroom: smoke detector + notification'; and FA-1's OWN audibility chart says sleeping rooms are 'visual required'. AGAINST (vendor submittal, Hilton A/D&C reviewed 04/29/2025): FA-2/FA-3 draw NO horn and NO strobe in a standard key, and FA-1's schedule puts all 14 PC2WLED horn-strobes and 80 SCWLED strobes elsewhere. Precedence (submittal > drawing) points at FA-2/FA-3, which would mean the LF sounder base is the whole audible answer. DO NOT RESOLVE THIS IN THE FIELD — record what is installed. NOT APPLICABLE HERE regardless: A550/A555 keynote 43 (additional horn strobe in communication-features BATHROOMS) — 101 is not a communication-features key (A100 matrix, 'Queen Queen, HI' row empty on floor 1). Either answer closes the conflict; get it to Austin the same day.
lines.src: A555 keynote 16 + view 06 (H symbol drawn); A550 legend keynote 16 and keynote 43; A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND; E101 symbol legend (horn/strobe 6'-8" AFF); E501-E504; FA-1 audibility chart and device schedule; against FA-2/FA-3 (no horn in a standard key)
lines.verifyAtPunch: Record whether a horn or horn-strobe exists SEPARATE from the smoke detector — yes or no, with a photo of the ceiling and the wall above the door; if one is present, measure to it and record the mounting height.

lines.label: CONFIRM ABSENT - carbon monoxide detector. Silent Knight SKFIRECOW is scheduled qty 3 for the whole building and none is placed in a guest room
lines.where: Guest-room ceiling — expected absent
lines.instanceNote: EXPECTED QUANTITY IS ZERO — qty 1 means one CHECK. Emitted because a walker needs to know whether to expect one, and because this is an ABSENCE, not a verified exclusion: no sheet in the set states that guest rooms are exempt, it simply never places one. Guest rooms carry no fuel-fired appliance (the PTAC is electric at 208 V), so there is no obvious in-room trigger, but 3 CO detectors on a gas-fired hotel (laundry 4 dryers at 190 MBH, water-heater room 2 WH at 1,500 MBH) is a coverage question — 'confirm placement/coverage against local code'. Submittal code basis: 2018 IBC/IFC, 2019 NFPA 72, AHJ Eagle Pass, Group R-1. Hand Austin the open question separately — where do the 3 SKFIRECOW land and does Eagle Pass accept 3? That is a TCO conversation, not a room walk. NOTE M101's legend CO sensor is the garage/ventilation control family on M602, not a life-safety device.
lines.src: FA-1 schedule (CO / Silent Knight SKFIRECOW / qty 3, whole building, 'locate as shown on ceiling'); E500 CO detail (places none in a guest room); A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND (no CO symbol)
lines.verifyAtPunch: Confirm there is NO CO detector on the guest-room ceiling and note it on the sheet; if one IS installed, photograph it and log it — it is not scheduled to a room.

lines.label: Wireless access point in a 3-GANG BOX MOUNTED VERTICALLY under the desk — keynote 44 verbatim: 'WAP IN 3-GANG BOX MOUNTED VERTICALLY UNDER DESK. MAINTAIN 6" BETWEEN ALL BOXES, TYP ALL GUESTROOMS. COORDINATE WAP LOCATION WITH CASEGOODS TO AVOID CONFLICTS'
lines.where: Under the desk on the working wall; the A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND prints 'WAP (18")'
lines.instanceNote: Keynote 44 is confirmed in A555's placed-keynote list for views 04/04.1 and its own text reads 'TYP ALL GUESTROOMS'. A550/A555 keynote 44, FULL TEXT, verbatim (the draft truncated this and still relied on the cut-off clause — corrected): 'WAP IN 3-GANG BOX MOUNTED VERTICALLY UNDER DESK. MAINTAIN 6" BETWEEN ALL BOXES, TYP ALL GUESTROOMS. COORDINATE WAP LOCATION WITH CASEGOODS TO AVOID CONFLICTS. VISIT CONNECTEDROOM.HILTON.COM FOR CURRENT WIRELESS INTERNET REQ'S AND LIST OF APPROVED INTEGRATORS.' Carried at HIGH for the item, but know the design gap behind it: NO WAP appears in ANY E-series schedule — no count, no circuit, no cabling design (packages/electrical.md open item 8), and there is no telecom riser diagram, rack elevation or port count anywhere in this set. The integrator requirement comes from the keynote's own last clause, so the punch reference for the installation is the Hilton-approved integrator's as-built, not the E-series. This box is the hub of the room: the TV CAT6 runs to it in smurf tube and the desk-grommet data can be a patch cord off its port.

lines.label: TV outlet behind the television — CAT6 RJ-45 jack always, coax ONLY if option A was built
lines.where: Working wall behind the TV (FF&E tag 903); A555 elevations 05 and 09 carry keynote 47
lines.instanceNote: THE DB DESCRIPTION OVERSTATES THE SHEET — it lists coax AND CAT6 as though both are required, which is keynote 47 OPTION A only. Keynote 47 prints two mutually exclusive options and NO SHEET SELECTS ONE: 'A) NO SMART TV: COAX CABLE BEHIND TV. CAT6 RJ-45 JACK BEHIND TV, RUN IN SMURF TUBE IN WALL TO WAP UNDER DESK. PATCH CORD TO EDGE CONTROLLER FOR CONNECTED ROOM. MIN. 6" CLEARANCE FROM WALL BOXES - OR - B) SMART TV-INTERNET PROTOCOL TELEVISION (IPTV) COAX NOT REQ'D. CAT6 RJ-45 JACK BEHIND TV RUN IN SMURF TUBE IN WALL TO WAP UNDER DESK. PATCH CORD TO EDGE CONTROLLER FOR CONNECTED ROOM...'. It turns on whether the procured televisions are smart/IPTV sets — an owner/FF&E decision, not a drawing one. THE CAT6 RJ-45 JACK IS REQUIRED UNDER BOTH OPTIONS — punch that unconditionally. DO NOT write up a missing coax until the TV question is answered. Keynote 47 adds a second jack only 'IN ONE-BEDROOM TV' — there are none on floor 1, so no second jack here. HEIGHT IS OPEN: 12" (A530 general note D) vs 18" (E101 spec #18, E101 legend 'TV outlet w/F (18" AFF)', G400 detail 02); A530 general note F's 15"-48" band is printed unqualified and is carried as a further source, though a TV outlet is arguably not a 'control' — both readings recorded, neither adopted. Record the height.
lines.src: A555 keynote 47 (views 04/04.1 + elevations 05/09); A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND 'OUTLET - TV'; E101 General Note 8 and symbol legend; A530 general notes D and F; G400 detail 02
lines.verifyAtPunch: Confirm a CAT6 RJ-45 jack is present behind the TV with a PANDUIT lock on the connection; record whether coax is also present; measure and record the height; establish which keynote-47 option was bought before writing anything up.

Record it, do not judge it.

lines.label: Telephone outlet (FF&E tag 905) fed by 3/4" conduit with pull string
lines.where: Nightstand / bed area at the 905 telephone position tagged on A555 view 01
lines.instanceNote: ITEM IS CERTAIN; COUNT IS DERIVED, NOT PRINTED — 1 comes from the 905 TELEPHONE tag being placed once on A555 view 01, not from a drop schedule. E101 specification #16 requires the telephone outlet locations be coordinated with the owner and a 3/4" conduit with pull string provided. HEIGHT OPEN: 12" (A530 general note D) vs 18" (E101 symbol legend 'telephone outlet (18" AFF)', spec #18, G400 detail 02); A530 general note F's unqualified 15"-48" band carried as a further source. THE NOTE THAT BITES AT PUNCH is G402 guestroom-bath general note 9, verbatim: 'PROVIDE AN ELECTRICAL OUTLET WITHIN 48" OF THE TELEPHONE CONNECTION. THE OUTLET MUST HAVE A CLEAR FLOOR SPACE AND MEET ACCESSIBILITY STANDARDS FOR REACH RANGE.' That is a measurable, enforceable dimension and it is not scoped to accessible rooms. Also E400 General Note 1 and E101 spec #28 prohibit back-to-back boxes INCLUDING telephone — at least 6" offset from the adjacent guestroom's box, 24" at the rated/acoustic W4 and W5 walls.
lines.src: E101 specification #16 and symbol legend; A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND 'PHONE'; A555 view 01 tag 905; G402 guestroom-bath general note 9; E400 General Note 1; E101 spec #28; A530 general notes D and F
lines.verifyAtPunch: Plug in the handset and confirm dial tone; then measure from the telephone jack to the nearest electrical outlet — it must be within 48" and that outlet must have clear floor space in front of it. Write both numbers down.

lines.label: Doorbell on/off switch (keyed note 28) — 'DOORBELL ON/OFF SWITCH (COMMUNICATION FEATURES ROOMS ONLY) SIGNAGE AS REQ'D.' EXPECT ZERO IN 217.
lines.where: Would be at the entry door — but this room is not a communication-features key
lines.instanceNote: DB ROW NOT SUPPORTED FOR THIS ROOM — EXPECTED QUANTITY IS ZERO, and qty 1 means one CHECK. A550/A555 keynote 28 verbatim: 'DOORBELL ON/OFF SWITCH (COMMUNICATION FEATURES ROOMS ONLY) SIGNAGE AS REQ'D.' The keynote IS drawn on A555 views 04/04.1 and elevation 07 and DOORBELL (DB) is on the power & signal legend — a field electrician reading this sheet sees a DB symbol, which is exactly why this check is worth performing — but the keynote's own text restricts it to communication-features rooms, and A100's Guestroom Matrix settles that room 101 is not one: the floor-1 column reads 'Queen Queen (Wide), CD = 1 S' with NO HI suffix, and the 'Queen Queen, HI' row is EMPTY on floor 1. The single floor-1 hearing-impaired key is a KING STUDIO ('King Studio, HI = 1 T'), i.e. one of 104/106/108/110/112/114. MOBILITY-ACCESSIBLE IS NOT HEARING-ACCESSIBLE and neither applies here: 101 carries no HA and no HI. Building-wide only some of the 12 HI keys are located and floor 1 has never been scanned for the crossed-ear symbol (coordination_issues C-04) — but that open item cannot put a doorbell in a QQ on floor 1, because the matrix zeroes the QQ HI row. DO NOT PUNCH THIS ROOM FOR A MISSING DOORBELL. Retained as a line so the correction is visible, not silent.
lines.src: A555 keynote 28 (placed on views 04/04.1 and elevation 07); A550 legend keynote 28; A550/A555 POWER & SIGNAL LEGEND 'DOORBELL (DB)'; against A100 Guestroom Matrix floor-1 column; coordination_issues C-04
lines.verifyAtPunch: Confirm there is NO doorbell push at the corridor side of the entry door, NO on/off switch inside, and no orphan blank plate or capped box — if any of those IS present, photograph it and log it as unaccounted for.
